name: Momoiro Sankaku ~Riko & Hikaru Hen~
original_name: もも色さんかく～理子&ひかる篇～
source:
Riko and Hikaru and normal girls who live normal lives. One attends kendo club, the other is a fan of reading. But one day their wolds coincide in one.
